# The four model vendors' published terms are read for what they say about publishing model output
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #367, sha256:fb9a341ac2e944c71e713c07fcd9c7f183f867d81ab25b94f970d4d443b9cfec). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Draft
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** story
- **Repository:** avowry (docs/release)
- **Source:** product-owner answers to the nine owner items on docs/release/pre-publication-checks.md, inbox entry of 2026-11-08 (card 186). Ranked before the v0.1 publish card.
- **Depends on:** none
- **Story:** As Dana, I want a summary of what each of the four model vendors' current terms and usage policies say about publishing model output, so that I know whether the bench reply prefixes and the seat replies in this repository can be public.
- **Consumer value:** Dana (and the sponsor persona) can judge publication risk from a cited summary and a list of blockers, not from unread terms.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Scenario: [O][S] one cited summary per vendor
     Given the four vendors the mob uses
     When a seat reads each vendor's current published terms of service and usage policy by web fetch only
     Then a page cites each URL with the date read and summarises what it says about publishing model output, covering the bench reply prefixes and the seat replies under .mob/records
  2. Scenario: [Z][B] blockers are flagged
     Given the summaries
     When any term would block publication
     Then the page names it with the quoted URL and a recommendation; when none does, it says so
  3. Scenario: [I] no unread vendor remains
     Given the four vendors listed in the pre-publication page
     When the page is checked
     Then a test fails if a vendor has no URL and no read date
- **Not in this card:** Legal advice; reading terms by any means but web fetch; changing any row already pushed.
- **Size:** M
